spec.why: Finish the deferred real host acceptance across Linux, macOS and native Windows.

requirements.text: Verify Claude Code on all required operating systems and lifecycle checks.
Verify Codex CLI on all required operating systems and lifecycle checks.
Verify Codex desktop and IDE on all required operating systems and lifecycle checks.
Verify pi on all required operating systems and lifecycle checks.

out_of_scope: Implementation redesign, remote services and publication

tasks.title: Verify Claude Code native host journeys
tasks.detail: Required platforms: linux, darwin, win32. Required surfaces: claude. Required checks: clean install; human activation/trust; project selection; new spec; continue spec; stop and next-event restart; session exit leaves server running; upgrade and removal preserve foreign configuration; owner workflow. Preserve actual observations and distinguish human host trust from callback fixtures.

verify.expect: All required native surface/platform witnesses have actual versions, commands, zero exits, observations and human activation/trust evidence; missing/unrun combinations fail.

notes: Read brief.md, spec.md, design.md and plan.md; do not treat existing runtime smoke as real host activation.

checks: upgrade and removal preserve foreign configuration
